text:
Elliot Price: Heads up, IA/navigation tweak PR is up for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/904

Main change is grouping Streaming + Tools + Structured Output under a single left-nav section and updating a couple sidebar labels. Can folks sanity check:
- new nav labels/ordering
- we’re not breaking discoverability for quickstarts / SDK guides
- any missing cross-links we should add while we’re here

Wei Chen: Took a pass. +1 on grouping, but I think we need explicit cross-links from the Quickstart pages. Right now Hosted API quickstart still links to the legacy “function calling” page.

Specifically:
- /docs/quickstart -> links to /docs/guides/function-calling (old)
- /docs/sdks/python -> references “Streaming responses” but doesn’t deep link to the new section

If we ship the nav without updating those, people will still land on old URLs via internal links.

Kira Thompson: Agree. Also Dedicated/Private operator notes mention “streaming logs” and currently link to the old streaming page. Even if the nav is fixed, folks won’t find the new troubleshooting callouts unless we point them there.

Two asks:
1) Make sure the new section pages have stable anchors we can link to (e.g. #reconnect, #proxy-buffering).
2) Add a small “See also: Quickstarts / SDK guides” block at the bottom of each of the 3 pages, if that’s not too heavy.

Dana Lo: On the SDK guide side: TS guide currently links to `/docs/hosted/streaming` (hardcoded). If the new nav uses different paths, we should either keep the route or add redirects.

Also minor: left nav label “Structured Output” vs “Structured outputs” (plural) — we should pick one and match the rest.

Monica Patel: +1 to redirect plan. From support POV, internal links are a bigger issue than nav. If we can’t land redirects in this PR, at least add a follow-up checklist item to ensure old links resolve.

Re: cross-links, I’d prioritize:
- Quickstarts -> Streaming / Tools / Structured Output
- SDK guides -> same
- “Troubleshooting streaming disconnects” gets linked from streaming page (we get a ton of proxy buffering tickets)

Sabrina James: I can help patch the quickstart links if we want to keep PR 904 focused on nav only. But if we’re already touching the pages, it might be cleaner to update internal links in the same PR.

Wei Chen: Another small thing: the new nav grouping is great, but the page titles/H1s should remain the canonical SEO terms. E.g. “Streaming responses” not “Streaming” (nav label can be shorter).

Kira Thompson: +1. Nav label short is fine, but H1 should match existing external links/bookmarks.

Elliot Price: This is super helpful. Plan:
- Keep nav label short, keep H1s as-is.
- Add redirects for the old URLs (at least the ones we know are linked internally).
- Update Quickstart + SDK guide internal links to point to the new section pages.
- Make sure anchors exist for reconnect/proxy buffering + structured output validation.

I’ll push an update shortly. If anyone has a list of the worst offending old URLs, drop them here.

Dana Lo: Worst offenders from TS side:
- /docs/guides/function-calling
- /docs/hosted/streaming
- /docs/guides/json-mode

If those redirect to the new Tools / Streaming / Structured Output pages, that’s most of it.

Wei Chen: Hosted quickstart references:
- /docs/guides/function-calling
- /docs/guides/streaming (this one exists but old content)

Also, a couple snippets link to “JSON mode” terminology. Might be worth a small note at top of Structured Output page: “Structured output (aka JSON mode)” to catch search.

Elliot Price: Update pushed to PR 904:
- added redirects for the three old guides paths Dana listed
- updated quickstart + SDK guide cross-links (Python/TS/Go landing pages)
- nav label: “Structured Output” (singular) to match PM-approved terminology
- added anchors: #reconnect-and-resume, #proxy-buffering, #schema-validation-and-retries

Would love a final look before I ask for merge. :pray:

Wei Chen: Reviewed latest commit. Links look good now, and redirects cover the quickstart paths. :thumbsup: (reaction)

Kira Thompson: LGTM. Anchors are there and the Dedicated/Private operator note link resolves after redirect. :white_check_mark:

Dana Lo: Confirmed TS guide link now points to new tools page and anchor exists. Good to merge.

Monica Patel: +1 from DevEx. Please add a tiny note in the PR description that we updated internal cross-links + redirects, so it doesn’t get missed in release notes.

Elliot Price: Done. Thanks all — merging once CI is green.
